reached_sql:
CREATE INDEX idx_store_sales_item_sk ON store_sales(ss_item_sk);
CREATE INDEX idx_store_sales_sold_date_sk ON store_sales(ss_sold_date_sk);
CREATE INDEX idx_store_sales_store_sk ON store_sales(ss_store_sk);
CREATE INDEX idx_item_category_class_brand ON item(i_category, i_class, i_brand);

WITH tmp1 AS (
    SELECT i_manager_id, 
           sum(ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
           avg(sum(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_manager_id) AS avg_monthly_sales
    FROM item
    JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_month_seq BETWEEN 1222 AND 1232
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    WHERE ((i_category IN ('Books', 'Children', 'Electronics') AND i_class IN ('personal', 'portable', 'reference', 'self-help') AND i_brand IN ('scholaramalgamalg #14', 'scholaramalgamalg #7', 'exportiunivamalg #9', 'scholaramalgamalg #9')) OR (i_category IN ('Women', 'Music', 'Men') AND i_class IN ('accessories', 'classical', 'fragrances', 'pants') AND i_brand IN ('amalgimporto #1', 'edu packscholar #1', 'exportiimporto #1', 'importoamalg #1')))
    GROUP BY i_manager_id, d_moy
)
SELECT * FROM tmp1
WHERE CASE WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales ELSE NULL END > 0.1
ORDER BY i_manager_id, avg_monthly_sales, sum_sales
LIMIT 100
